dogecoin.text: I find myself searching crypto names like $DOGE and $SHIB on Twitter and most of what you find are people trying to pump up these coins or pull people away from these coins for other projects.

I just bought 500k $SHIB. 

If it gets to the same high that $DOGE got to, I’d be a happy man.
All of the Crypto that I watch is going nuts. Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin and Shiba are green. Doge is up almost 25%.
